# Milestone Zero plans in Highway Town (Windy, Dom Pedro, V63 Laser Karabiner and others)

![Milestone Zero Plans in Highway Town (Windy, Dom Pedro, V63 Laser Karabiner and others)](/uploads/601_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The Milestone Zero location in the south of Skyline Valley, as well as the caravans and all the traders from there, are now history. Unfortunately, this will also remove your progress for the upgrades. What remains are your learned blueprints.

But the good news is: **Windy is now in the game** and active as a new merchant in **Highway Town** in Burning Springs. Windy brings her blueprints into the game, which have not been published before. And you can also find the other blueprints at the other dealers in Highway Town. The remaining blueprints were distributed between the rewards from the spooky Burnt Ones and the Holiday Burnt Ones.

Bethesda wrote about this in the PTS patch notes:

The bandits searching for caravans to rob in Skyline Valley have proven to be a dangerous threat to the Blue Ridge Caravan Company. They frighten the poor Brahmin so that they go astray and deliveries remain incomplete.

For now, Milestone Zero is closing up shop and offering its wares to other traders in Highway Town. It is hoped that the situation will be a little safer again in the future.

**With the release of Burning Springs in early December, all players who have completed the caravan introductory quest “Stumbling Blocks” will receive the title “Caravan Investor”. Additionally, they will receive 2,000 gold bars and a new caravan pennant.**

We believe Bounty Hunt delivers on the same promise of on-demand content with legendary enemies and great rewards - in a more compact and satisfying way. We love the Skyline Valley region and have some exciting new developments planned for the future.

Highway Town is the central main point in Burning Springs, where you will find all the important retailers and get e.g. Bounty orders. The main quest from Burning Springs also takes you there.

![Highway Town](/uploads/nukaknights-post-milepost-highway-town-hwt-map.jpg) 

## Windy in Highway Town

As you know, Windy has been available on the PTS several times, but never in the live version. So the plans they offered were never available. Now she is an integral part of Highway Town and has opened her shop there. There you will now receive all **Plans for Gold**.

![Windy in Highway Town](/uploads/nukaknights-post-milepost-highway-town-20251118164033-1.jpg)

## V63 Laser Carbine in Highway Town

The blueprints that you previously got from Theodore in Milestone Zero can now be sold by “Splint” in Highway Town. She's an arms dealer and now sells the **plans for bottle caps**.

Their store is located across from the Last Resort.

![Splint (V63 Laser Carbine Vendor)](/uploads/nukaknights-post-milepost-highway-town-splint-vendor.png)

## More plans in Highway Town

The **dealer Mac** sells additional tarpaulins from milestone zero. This has its shop opposite the main entrance. He also sells the **plans for bottle caps** now.

In addition to the listed "Milestone Zero" plans, he also sells some workshop, armor and sub-armor plans as well as some scrap.
